items.description: Ehoala Port is a modern deep-water port located in the south of Madagascar, serving the mining industry.
The Star Brewery in Antsirabe is one of the largest industrial plants in the city, producing popular local beverages.
The fisheries of Nosy Be are vital for the local economy, specializing in shrimp and seafood export.
Maintirano Port is a key maritime gateway on the west coast, handling regional trade and supplies.
The Dutch settlement in Antongil Bay dates back to the early 17th century when it was a base for spice trade.
Antongona features 18th-century royal hill forts with unique architecture, located near the capital.
Analamazaotra Station is a historic colonial outpost set in the dense rainforest of the eastern highlands.
The colonial center of Toliara retains much of its French architectural heritage from the early 20th century.
Cap Miné is a historic lighthouse and military site guarding the entrance to the vast bay of Diego Suarez.
The fort on Nosy Boraha (Sainte Marie) is a relic of the island's colorful history of piracy and colonization.
Alasora is one of the twelve sacred hills of Imerina and was the seat of early Merina royalty.
Nosy Mangabe features historic 17th-century inscriptions left by Dutch sailors on the island's rocks.
The Cap Miné Lighthouse is a prominent landmark providing guidance to ships entering the northern tip of Madagascar.
Hotel des Thermes is a grand colonial-style hotel in Antsirabe, reflecting the city's elegant past as a spa town.
The Kamoro Bridge is a vital engineering structure on the RN4 highway, connecting Antananarivo with Mahajanga.
